history: The bar-trick version. Widely ordered and widely done badly.
whyItWorks: The flame caramelises the overproof rum and nothing else; the flavour is the same Dr Pepper trick underneath.
steps: Half-fill a glass with beer and set it down clear of anything flammable.
Fill a shot glass with amaretto and float the overproof rum on top.
Light the float, then drop the shot into the beer — the beer extinguishes it on contact.
Drink only once the flame is out.
techniqueNotes: Fire safety is the whole technique here: no overhanging hair or sleeves, no spirit bottles within reach, and a damp cloth on the bar.
Never move or hand over a lit glass, and never relight one.
The drop extinguishes it. If the flame survives the drop, cover the glass and start again.
name: Flaming Dr Pepper
description: A Dr Pepper Shot with an overproof float, lit and dropped.
